id: 20
slug: top-k
title: Top K
difficulty: easy
signature: int[] topK(int[] nums, int k)
time_limit_ms: 500
---
A fixture for full-size cases (@full in tests.txt): return the k largest
values of `nums`, largest first. gen.c makes 100000 numbers, with k = 3
(a short result, kept in tests.txt) or k = n (a long one, which ref works
out when the case is judged).

@examples
